units.title: Multi-Pass Energy Cascade Validation
units.description: Map E-code progression to energy cascade, validate Toenshoff model (gamma=0.20-0.35) against real pass energy ratios

units.title: Calibration Report Generator
units.description: Create WEDMCalibrationReportEngine that summarizes per-parameter deviation, calibration constants, and confidence intervals
